limitations: 114 discovered URL(s) were never fetched (permission, acquisition failure, or budget constraints; out of 120 discovered); findings reflect only the 6 page(s) actually crawled, not the whole site. The sample reached 4 of 23 site sections (first path segment).

Headless browser rendering was not available in this environment; rendering-gap findings are based on a static-content heuristic only and are reported as suspected/insufficient_evidence rather than confirmed.
No external search provider was configured; claim corroboration and off-site footprint assessment were not checked this run (not the same as "nothing found").
Linked sameAs and review profiles were not fetched (OFF_SITE_LOOKUP=0), so whether they resolve and belong to the brand was not checked.
Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) were not measured: the audit runs no browser and no PAGESPEED_API_KEY is configured. Web-vitals findings are estimates from markup patterns, not measurements.
Colour contrast and tap-target size were judged only where inline styles set them; colours and sizes from stylesheets need a browser to compute and were not assessed.
13 same-origin content image(s) were not measured for file size (per-audit cap of 4 or remaining budget); cross-origin images are never requested, so their weight is unassessed.
sitemap.xml could not be checked (status: 'blocked'); crawl coverage may be incomplete relative to a site that publishes one.

confidence.method: min(sample_representativeness, observation_completeness, execution_penalty), where sample_representativeness = max(crawl_completeness, min(section_coverage, sample_size)), capped at 0.9 unless discovery_reliable is true, and crawl_completeness = pages_analyzed / pages_discovered; observation_completeness = (pages read in full + half of pages read in part) / (pages analyzed + challenged, waiting-room, timed-out and failed fetches). A weak link caps the score rather than being averaged out. identity_confidence is reported beside the score, not in it: it gates only the checks that depend on the brand's identity
confidence.interpretation: A heuristic rating of how far the report speaks for the whole site, not a calibrated probability. Each finding states its own confidence.

reasons.sample_representativeness: The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 6 of 120 discovered page(s) and reached 4 of 23 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched).
reasons.observation_completeness: Every page the audit tried to read was read in full.
reasons.identity_confidence: No Organization or Product JSON-LD was found on the analyzed pages, so the audit could not confirm which brand the site belongs to. Adding Organization markup raises this part.

confidence.explanation: Confidence is low (0.17). The weakest of its parts sets the score, here the page sample. The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 6 of 120 discovered page(s) and reached 4 of 23 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched). Brand identity (reported separately, not part of the score): No Organization or Product JSON-LD was found on the analyzed pages, so the audit could not confirm which brand the site belongs to. Adding Organization markup raises this part. The score rates how far the report speaks for the whole site; each finding has its own confidence and status, and a problem seen on a page is still real on that page.
